subject.title: fix(mcp): coerce string numeric tool args to numbers per inputSchema (#107648)

question: Should OpenClaw normalize schema-invalid numeric strings centrally for every bundled MCP server, or should the confirmed serialization defect be repaired at the specific upstream adapter that changes the model’s typed arguments?
rationale: The linked report does not yet prove that this dispatch seam receives a string, while the proposed central transform affects all bundled MCP tool calls and crosses a security-sensitive argument boundary.

options.title: Trace first, then keep a safe central normalizer if confirmed
options.body: Capture the value entering `runtime.callTool`, repair the unsafe object copy, and retain this shared normalization only if that trace demonstrates the common failure.

options.title: Repair the upstream serialization boundary
options.body: If the value is already a number at materialization, fix the provider or transport layer that alters it later instead of adding a general MCP rewrite.

recommendation.title: Trace first, then keep a safe central normalizer if confirmed
recommendation.body: Capture the value entering `runtime.callTool`, repair the unsafe object copy, and retain this shared normalization only if that trace demonstrates the common failure.

likelyOwner.reason: They can supply the exact runtime trace for the proposed boundary; current-main feature ownership could not be derived while local read-only inspection was unavailable.
